name: CardStack
label: Card stack
description: A deck of cards showing one at a time, flipped through with a lift-and-settle animation.

props.name: children
props.description: The cards, in order. The first child starts on top.

props.name: index
props.description:
Controlled top card, as an index into `children`. Pair with
`onIndexChange`. Omit to let the stack own its position.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Fires when the top card changes, with the new index.

props.name: peek
props.description: How many card edges peek out behind the top card.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last card back to the first. Off, the stack stops at both ends.

props.name: advanceOnClick
props.description:
Clicking the top card flips to the next. Clicks that land on a link or
control inside the card are left alone, so a card can still carry its
own actions.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the stack, e.g. "Open roles".

props.name: positionLabel
props.description:
Visually hidden status announcing the top card's place in the deck, given
its 1-based position and the card count. Defaults to "Card 2 of 5".
